If the raw fields for a property entry is not an object,
warn and discard all fields.

-- test.glx --
persons:
    person-with-error:
        properties:
            name:
                value: Person with Error
                # fields requires map[string]any
                fields: "string instead of map of fields"
    person-well-formed:
        properties:
            name:
                value: Person well Formed
                fields:
                    given: Person
                    surname_prefix: well
                    surname: Formed

-- want-errors --
persons\[person-with-error\].Properties.name: all fields discarded: expected object, got string

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    person-with-error:
        properties:
            name:
                definition:
                    label: Name
                    value_type: string
                entries:
                -   value: StringValue{"Person with Error"}
    person-well-formed:
        properties:
            name:
                definition:
                    label: Name
                    value_type: string
                entries:
                -   value: StringValue{"Person well Formed"}
                    fields:
                        given:
                            definition:
                                label: Given Name
                            value: StringValue{"Person"}
                        surname_prefix:
                            definition:
                                label: Surname Prefix
                            value: StringValue{"well"}
                        surname:
                            definition:
                                label: Surname
                            value: StringValue{"Formed"}
